items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: He was a wonderful trumpet player, but I never had the pleasure of working with him. I wasn't there.

ctx.x: Cootie, it just would be nice to talk a minute with you about some of the guys that you worked with, and some of the guys that you knew one way or another, and just see what you might have to say. Sometimes you won't have anything to say, but for instance, well, what about Harold Baker. I know, let's take some trumpet players, because you've always got something to say about trumpet players. What about Harold? What kind of musician was Harold?
